query: query: How can I reset my forgotten password?
positive: passage: Select Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your registered email address and follow the password-reset link.
negative: passage: Open the Billing page to download your payment receipt.

query: query: Where can I change my current password?
positive: passage: Sign in, open Settings, select Security, and choose Change Password.
negative: passage: Select Forgot Password when you cannot remember your existing password.

query: query: My payment was deducted but the balance was not updated.
positive: passage: Check the transaction status first. If the payment succeeded but your balance was not updated, contact support with the transaction ID.
negative: passage: Clear your conversation history from the Privacy section.

query: query: Can I download my previous invoices?
positive: passage: Open Billing, select Payment History, and choose Download Invoice beside the required transaction.
negative: passage: Open Security settings to change your password.

query: query: நான் என்னுடைய கடவுச்சொல்லை மறந்துவிட்டேன். என்ன செய்ய வேண்டும்?
positive: passage: உள்நுழைவு பக்கத்தில் Forgot Password என்பதைத் தேர்வு செய்து, பதிவு செய்யப்பட்ட மின்னஞ்சல் முகவரியை உள்ளிடுங்கள்.
negative: passage: Billing பகுதியில் உங்கள் கட்டண வரலாற்றைப் பார்க்கலாம்.

query: query: என் payment deduct ஆனது, ஆனால் balance update ஆகவில்லை.
positive: passage: Transaction status-ஐ சரிபார்க்கவும். Payment successful ஆகி balance update ஆகவில்லை என்றால் transaction ID-யுடன் support-ஐ தொடர்புகொள்ளவும்.

query: query: How do I change the application language to Tamil?
positive: passage: Open Settings, select Language, and choose Tamil from the available language options.
negative: passage: Open Account Security to reset your password.

query: query: App language Tamil-ku change panna எப்படி?
positive: passage: Settings-ஐ திறந்து Language பகுதியில் Tamil என்பதைத் தேர்வு செய்யுங்கள்.
negative: passage: Billing History பகுதியில் invoice download செய்யலாம்.

query: query: I uploaded a document. How can I ask questions about it?
positive: passage: After the upload completes, open the document conversation and ask a question related to its contents.
negative: passage: Select Delete Account to permanently remove your profile.

query: query: The uploaded document is not being processed.
positive: passage: Confirm that the file type is supported and retry the upload. If processing still fails, remove the file and upload it again.
negative: passage: Change the application theme from Appearance settings.

query: query: How can I permanently delete my account?
positive: passage: Open Settings, select Account, choose Delete Account, and complete the confirmation process.
negative: passage: Use Forgot Password to create a new password.

query: query: என் account-ஐ permanently delete செய்வது எப்படி?
positive: passage: Settings பகுதியில் Account என்பதைத் தேர்வு செய்து Delete Account option-ஐ பயன்படுத்துங்கள். Confirmation முடிந்ததும் account நீக்கப்படும்.
negative: passage: Language பகுதியில் Tamil தேர்வு செய்யலாம்.

query: query: Does the application support voice conversations?
positive: passage: Voice conversation is available when microphone permission is enabled. Tap the microphone button to begin speaking.
negative: passage: Invoices can be downloaded from Payment History.

query: query: Microphone வேலை செய்யவில்லை. என்ன செய்யலாம்?
positive: passage: Device settings-ல் microphone permission enabled உள்ளதா என்பதை சரிபார்த்து, application-ஐ மீண்டும் திறக்கவும்.
negative: passage: Password reset link உங்கள் email-க்கு அனுப்பப்படும்.

query: query: I do not know the answer from the available documents.
positive: passage: When the required information is not present in the available sources, clearly state that the answer cannot be confirmed from the provided documents.
negative: passage: Invent a likely answer even when no supporting information is available.
